70885-cape-cod.title: Cape Cod
70885-cape-cod.creator: Unknown
70885-cape-cod.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. merica’s prime coastal recreational areas. Cape Cod National Seashore, managed by the National Park Service, extends for 40 miles along the Cape’s outer arm between Chatham and Provincetown. In Part 1 of this handbook, author and longtime resident Robert Finch introduces the reader to the Cape’s rich cultural and natural history and to the National Seashore.

arxiv-1808-05865.title: Using path signatures to predict a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease. Journal: arxiv.org
arxiv-1808-05865.creator: P.J. Moore, J. Gallacher, T.J. Lyons, for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-1808-05865.description: Abstract The path signature is a means of feature generation that can encode nonlinear interactions in the data as well as the usual linear features. It can distinguish the ordering of time-sequenced changes: for example whether or not the hippocampus shrinks fast, then slowly or the converse.

arxiv-2001-01098.title: On the stochastic Magnus expansion and its application to SPDEs
arxiv-2001-01098.creator: Kevin Kamm, Stefano Pagliarani, Andrea Pascucci
arxiv-2001-01098.description: Abstract We derive the stochastic version of the Magnus expansion for linear systems of stochastic differential equations (SDEs). The main novelty with respect to the related literature is that we consider SDEs in the Itô sense, with progressively measurable coefficients, for which an explicit Itô-Stratonovich conversion is not available.

arxiv-2201-00279.title: Influence of moments of inertia on transverse wobbling mode in odd-mass nuclei
arxiv-2201-00279.creator: H. Zhang, B. Qi, X. D. Wang, H. Jia, S. Y. Wang
arxiv-2201-00279.description: Abstract The reported transverse wobbling band in odd-mass 105 Pd has been reinvestigated by the triaxial particle rotor model. Employing different parameter sets of moment of inertia (MOI), several calculated results could be in good agreement with the experimental data, which show distinct modes of rotational excitation, respectively.

arxiv-2204-09695.title: Ab initio guided minimal model for the “Kitaev” material BaCo 2 (AsO 4 ) 2 : Importance of direct hopping, third-neighbor exchange and quantum fluctuations Supplemental Materials
arxiv-2204-09695.creator: Pavel A. Maksimov, Alexey V. Ushakov, Zlata V. Pchelkina, Ying Li, Stephen M. Winter, Sergey V. Streltsov
arxiv-2204-09695.description: Abstract pacs 71.27.+a, 71.20.-b, 71.15.Mb I DFT calculation details We carried out an ab initio band structure calculations within the frameworks of density functional theory (DFT) as implemented in VASP Kresse and Furthmüller 1996a ; Kresse and Furthmüller 1996b ; Kresse and Hafner 1994 and a full-potential local-orbital code (FPLO) Eschrig et al. 2004 .

arxiv-2305-14231.title: Triggering boundary phase transitions through bulk measurements in two-dimensional cluster states
arxiv-2305-14231.creator: Yuchen Guo, Jian-Hao Zhang, Zhen Bi, Shuo Yang
arxiv-2305-14231.description: Abstract We investigate the phase diagram at the boundary of an infinite two-dimensional cluster state subject to bulk measurements using tensor network methods. The state is subjected to uniform measurements M = cos ⁡ θ ​ Z + sin ⁡ θ ​ X M=\cos{\theta}Z+\sin{\theta}X on the lower boundary qubits and in all bulk qubits.

arxiv-2307-00809.title: Non-uniqueness & inadmissibility of the vanishing viscosity limit of the passive scalar transport equation Thanks: Keywords : Passive scalar transport equation; non-uniqueness of vanishing viscosity limit; nonphysical and entropy inadmissibility of vanishing viscosity limit; vanishing viscosity limi
arxiv-2307-00809.creator: Lucas Huysmans, Edriss S. Titi
arxiv-2307-00809.description: Abstract . We study selection by vanishing viscosity for the transport of a passive scalar f ⁡ ( x , t ) ∈ ℝ f(x,t)\in\mathbb{R} advected by a bounded, divergence-free vector field u ⁡ ( x , t ) ∈ ℝ 2 u(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}^{2} .

arxiv-2411-15975.title: Effective Theory Building and Manifold Learning
arxiv-2411-15975.creator: David Peter Wallis Freeborn
arxiv-2411-15975.description: Abstract Manifold learning and effective model building are generally viewed as fundamentally different types of procedure. After all, in one we build a simplified model of the data, in the other, we construct a simplified model of the another model.

arxiv-2501-07457.title: Lazy Reimplication in Chronological Backtracking
arxiv-2501-07457.creator: Robin Coutelier, Mathias Fleury, Laura Kovács
arxiv-2501-07457.description: Abstract Chronological backtracking is an interesting SAT solving technique within CDCL reasoning, as it backtracks less aggressively upon conflicts. However, chronological backtracking is more difficult to maintain due to its weaker SAT solving invariants. This paper introduces a lazy reimplication procedure for missed lower implications in chronological backtracking. Our method saves propagations by reimplying literals on demand, rather than eagerly.

arxiv-2504-00808.title: Retraction maps in optimal control of nonholonomic systems
arxiv-2504-00808.creator: Alexandre Anahory Simoes, María Barbero Liñán, Anthony Bloch, Leonardo Colombo, David Martín de Diego
arxiv-2504-00808.description: Abstract In this paper, we compare the performance of different numerical schemes in approximating Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle’s necessary conditions for the optimal control of nonholonomic systems. Retraction maps are used as a seed to construct geometric integrators for the corresponding Hamilton equations. First, we obtain an intrinsic formulation of a discretization map on a distribution 𝒟 \mathcal{D} .

arxiv-2509-03996.title: The role of coupling and timescales for interacting tipping elements
arxiv-2509-03996.creator: Paul D. L. RitchieRobbin Bastiaansen, Anna S. von der Heydt, Peter Ashwin
arxiv-2509-03996.description: Abstract Sudden and abrupt changes can occur in a nonlinear system within many fields of science when such a system crosses a tipping point and rapid changes of the system occur in response to slow changes in an external forcing. These can occur when time-varying inputs cross a bifurcation.

arxiv-2601-10519.title: Transformer-Based Cognitive Radio: Adaptive Modulation Strategies Using Transformer Models
arxiv-2601-10519.creator: Andrea Melis, Andrea Piroddi, Roberto Girau
arxiv-2601-10519.description: Abstract Cognitive Radio (CR) systems, which dynamically adapt to changing spectrum environments, could benefit significantly from advancements in machine learning technologies. These systems can be enhanced in terms of spectral efficiency, robustness, and security through innovative approaches such as the use of Transformer models.

pmc-10529766.title: Delta Cord as a Radiological Localization Sign of Postoperative Adhesive Arachnoiditis: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-10529766.creator: Yi-Ting Tu, Yung-Hsiao Chiang, Jiann-Her Lin, Frank Weber
pmc-10529766.description: Postoperative adhesive arachnoiditis is an inflammatory response of the spinal leptomeninges that occurs after surgery and results in scar formation in the avascular nature of the arachnoid layer. Clinical manifestations of postoperative adhesive arachnoiditis include pain, sensory deficits, motor dysfunction, reflex abnormalities, and bladder or bowel impairment.

pmc-10602320.title: Loading dose vitamin D3 improves vitamin D insufficiency in adults undergoing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-10602320.creator: Ni Bai, Karen Lee, Wasithep Limvorapitak, Emily Liu, David Kendler, Raewyn Broady, Jennifer White
pmc-10602320.description: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (aHSCT) patients are well known to be at high risk of vitamin D (vit D) deficiency. This study assessed whether a loading dose (100,000 IU) of vitamin D3 pre-aHSCT could effectively achieve and maintain sufficient post-transplant vit D levels (serum total 25 hydroxy vitamin D (25(OH)D) ≥ 75nmol/L).

pmc-11411231.title: Bilateral Spontaneous Thalamic Hemorrhage: A Case Report
pmc-11411231.creator: Zakariya A Al-Shahwani, Ghaith M Taha, Raghad N Saoodi, Mohanad Faisal
pmc-11411231.description: Bilateral spontaneous thalamic hemorrhage is a rare but serious condition often linked to hypertension. We report a 67-year-old male presenting with a sudden severe headache, decreased consciousness, and right-sided neurological deficits. Both CT and MRI confirmed bilateral thalamic hemorrhage. The patient was managed with supportive care and blood pressure control.

pmc-11480277.title: Impact of Disease Burden of Patients with Psoriasis on Biologic Therapy Switching: Real-World Evidence from the CorEvitas Psoriasis Registry
pmc-11480277.creator: Andrew Blauvelt, Robert R McLean, Silky W Beaty, Adam P Sima, Robert Low, Jeffrey L Stark, Laura McClung, Jerry Bagel
pmc-11480277.description: IntroductionDue to variable psoriasis symptoms, disease progression, and individual responses to therapy, patients may start, stop, or switch biologic therapies. Real-world data on the associated disease burden of patients with psoriasis who do and do not switch biologics are incomplete.

pmc-11603573.title: Effectiveness of Treatment with Stem Cells in Injuries of the Anterior Cruciate Ligament: A Systematic Review
pmc-11603573.creator: FF Buscariolo, C Gholmia, A Milani
pmc-11603573.description: ObjectivesDue to the lack of consensus, the objective of this systematic review was to describe the results in the literature with greater evidence on the effectiveness of stem cell (SC) treatment in ACL injuries, understanding their indications and updates on recommendation level.MethodsA systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-11698209.title: Childhood risk factors and clinical and service outcomes in adulthood in people with intellectual disabilities
pmc-11698209.creator: B. Perera, S. Mufti, C. Norris, A. Baksh, V. Totsika, A. Hassiotis, P. Hurks, T. van Amelsvoort
pmc-11698209.description: BackgroundAdults with intellectual disability experience increased rates of mental health disorders and adverse mental health outcomes.AimExplore childhood risk factors associated with adverse mental health outcomes during adulthood as defined by high cost of care, use of psychotropic medication without a severe mental illness and psychiatric hospital admissions.

pmc-12398007.title: The post-marketing safety of Esketamine among older adults(≥ 65): an real-world pharmacovigilance study
pmc-12398007.creator: Bin Deng, Zhiwen Fu, Linjie Li, Yusen Xu, Zihe Yang, Xuejia Zhai, Yongning Lv
pmc-12398007.description: AimsThis study aims to investigate the safety profile of Esketamine, with a particular focus on comparing adverse events (AEs) between adults (< 65 years) and older adults (≥ 65 years) using data from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS).MethodsWe conducted a comprehensive analysis of FAERS data from 2019 to 2024, identifying 6,452 Esketamine-related AE reports.
